title_as_printed: Isopiestic Molalities of MgSO4, MgCl2, KCl, and H2SO4 at 25 C (group 1: MgSO4 columns of the printed table)
reference_salt: KCl and H2SO4 (value2 = KCl, value3 = H2SO4, same equilibrium)
pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium at the equilibrium water vapour pressure; no pressure reported)
